ItemID: 1; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to add streaming to my TV setup, though I would need to check compatibility first.
ItemID: 2; Title: Echo Dot (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in accessories for my existing devices than adding a voice assistant.
ItemID: 3; Title: Samsung SSD 860 EVO 4TB 2.5 Inch SATA III Internal SSD (MZ-76E4T0B/AM); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My storage needs have centered on memory cards; I have no current internal-drive upgrade planned.
ItemID: 4; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A newer smart speaker still does not address a device accessory need I have right now.
ItemID: 5; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Streaming fits my TV use, but I would compare this with the 4K option and choose only one this time.
ItemID: 6; Title: 64GB EVO Select Memory Card and Sabrent SuperSpeed 2-Slot USB 3.0 Flash Memory Card Reader; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I frequently use memory cards for my devices, so extra capacity is useful; I would check compatibility since I already have a reader.
ItemID: 7; Title: TP-Link 24 Port Gigabit Ethernet Switch | Desktop/ Rackmount | Limited Lifetime Protection | Plug & Play | Shielded Ports | Sturdy Metal | Fanless Quiet | Traffic Optimization | Unmanaged (TL-SG1024S); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Twenty-four network ports are far beyond what I currently need for my electronics.
ItemID: 8; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already use a tablet and do not currently need another screen for voice assistance or calls.
ItemID: 9; Title: SABRENT 10 Port 60W USB 3.0 Hub with Individual Power Switches and LEDs Includes 60W 12V/5A Power Adapter (HB-BU10); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: With my card readers and other USB accessories, a powered hub could make connecting several devices more convenient.
ItemID: 10; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It could serve my streaming needs, but I would choose the 4K option from this page instead of buying multiple sticks.
